statement: A registered exact finite screen spans every charge coefficient on the PR 19 asymmetric codebooks and classifies scalar-output pairings by complete rational nullspaces and exact determinant polynomials. It constructs actual filtered crossings for the listed positive cutoffs and certifies singularity for the listed negative finite spaces. In particular lambda=2 admits removal of shifts -2..2 but not -5..5 in that raw-charge space. No all-size filter, cheaper rho or improved SAT exponent is obtained.
